action_instruction: Reviewing the billing and payment form fields from top to bottom
intent: PRIMARY: review the billing and payment form fields from top to bottom; role=text | HINTS: container=purchase form
rationale: The visible purchase form has been reviewed in document order.

action_instruction: Reading the billing and payment field order
intent: the ordered billing and payment field labels

action_params.condition: The billing and payment form fields appear in this order: Name, Address, City, State, Zip Code, Card Type, Credit Card Number, Month, Year, Name on Card.
action_params.query: the ordered billing and payment field labels
action_params.expected_value: Name, Address, City, State, Zip Code, Card Type, Credit Card Number, Month, Year, Name on Card

output_value: Name, Address, City, State, Zip Code, Card Type, Credit Card Number, Month, Year, Name on Card

action_instruction: Checking the Remember me checkbox placement
intent: whether the Remember me checkbox follows the Name on Card field

action_params.condition: A Remember me checkbox appears after the Name on Card field.
action_params.query: whether the Remember me checkbox follows the Name on Card field

intent: the Card Type dropdown option labels

action_params.condition: The Card Type options are exactly Visa and American Express.
action_params.query: the Card Type dropdown option labels

assertion_tree.description: the fields appear in this order: Name, Address, City, State, Zip Code, Card Type, Credit Card Number, Month, Year, Name on Card, the Card Type options are exactly Visa and American Express, and a Remember me checkbox appears after the Name on Card field.

sub_results.description: The billing and payment form fields appear in this order: Name, Address, City, State, Zip Code, Card Type, Credit Card Number, Month, Year, Name on Card.
sub_results.expected: Name, Address, City, State, Zip Code, Card Type, Credit Card Number, Month, Year, Name on Card
